UPDATE TB_ADVERTISEMENT
SET
status = 'PENDING_PUBLICATION',
processed_by_user_id = #{adminUserId},
approved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
rejection_reason = NULL
WHERE ad_id = #{adId}
AND status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL'

UPDATE TB_ADVERTISEMENT
SET
status = 'REJECTED',
rejection_reason = #{reason},
processed_by_user_id = #{adminUserId},
processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE ad_id = #{adId}
AND status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL'

UPDATE TB_ADVERTISEMENT
SET
status = 'ACTIVE',
processed_by_user_id = #{adminUserId},
processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE ad_id = #{adId}
AND status = 'PENDING_PUBLICATION'

UPDATE TB_ADVERTISEMENT
SET
status = 'WITHDRAWN',
processed_by_user_id = #{adminUserId},
processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE ad_id = #{adId}
AND status IN ( 'PENDING_PUBLICATION', 'ACTIVE' )

UPDATE TB_ADVERTISEMENT
SET
end_date = #{newEndDate},
processed_by_user_id = #{adminUserId},
processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE ad_id = #{adId}
AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE TB_ADVERTISEMENT
SET
status = 'DELETED',
processed_by_user_id = #{adminUserId},
processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE ad_id = #{adId}
AND status = 'ACTIVE'
